name: BsEntryKind
meaning: Leading u16 of an entry inside a Black Sheep geometry record. BsFile_SkipEntry 0x41fc89 switches on it to advance by count * stride, which is what defines the entry format: {u16 kind; u16 count; payload[count*stride]}. All 23 kinds 0x00..0x16 extracted from that switch (verified). The strides of the polygon decoders (0x10/0x11 = 12, 0x12/0x16 = 20, 0x13 = 24) match this table exactly; where a kind's MEANING is given it is inferred from its decoder.
